title: CS60046: Real Time Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to real time system, embedded systems and reactive systems; Hard
and soft real time systems; handling real time; specification and modeling;
design methods; real time operating systems; validation and verification; real
time process and applications; distributed real time systems.References1.R.
Mall, Real Time Systems: Theory and Practice, Pearson Education,
2007.2.C.M.Krishna and K.G.Shin, Real Time Systems, Tata McGraw Hill,
1997.3.Jane Liu, Real Time Systems, Pearson Education, 2000.
